versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' --buildcache '
        - ' --bhdump '
        - ' --certdump '
        - ' --dnsdump '
selection_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -c '
        - ' --cachefilename '
        - ' -o '
        - ' --outputdirectory'
condition: all of selection_*
